title: Monotonicity of segment conditions
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $F$ and $F'$ be sets of states with $F'\subseteq F$, and let $P$ and $P'$ be properties of work-tape head positions such that $P(p)$ implies $P'(p)$ for every position tuple $p$. If a run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps, avoids $F$ at every time $u<t$, and satisfies $P$ at every time $u\le t$, then it reaches the same endpoint after the same number of steps, avoids $F'$ at every time $u<t$, and satisfies $P'$ at every time $u\le t$.
hypotheses_covered: The run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps
The state at every time $u<t$ is outside $F$
The work-tape head positions satisfy $P$ at every time $u\le t$
